topic: Largest moon in the solar system
core_question: Which moon is the largest in the entire solar system? (secondary: How many hearts does an octopus have?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is Ganymede, a moon of Jupiter and the largest moon in the solar system.; after the topic shift: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the rest of the body.
persona: friendly but persistent; using casual slang
